title: Cloudways Review 2026: Plans, Pricing, AI Features and Black Friday Offer
excerpt: Cloudways starts at $11 a month with no contract. Here is how fast it was in independent tests, what the 80% Black Friday offer is really worth, and who should avoid it.

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Cloudways Review 2026: Pricing, Speed, AI, Black Friday
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Cloudways review for 2026: plan prices, what the 80% Black Friday offer is really worth, speed and uptime data from three sources, AI tools, pros and cons.
meta.rl_answer: Cloudways is fast, steady managed cloud hosting for established WordPress sites. Independent tests measured 99.996% to 99.999% uptime. The 80% Black Friday offer saves about 13% over the first year.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is Cloudways good? | Yes for established WordPress sites. Hostingstep measured 99.996% to 99.999% uptime across five plans, and Finding the Universe rated it 4.5 out of 5 after six years.
Is Cloudways good for beginners? | It is easier than running your own server, but harder than basic shared hosting. Several reviews mention a learning curve.
Is Cloudways good for SEO? | A fast server helps visitors and crawling. Hostingstep measured response times of 419 to 447 ms, but content and links still decide rankings.
How much does Cloudways cost? | Flexible plans on DigitalOcean start at $11 a month, and Micro is $14. Autonomous plans start at $99 a month. AI Agents plans start at $9.99 a month.
Does Cloudways have a free trial? | Yes. It lists a 5-day free trial on Flexible plans with no card needed, and a 3-day trial on Autonomous plans.
What is the Cloudways Black Friday offer? | 80% off for 2 months on all plans, with code BFCM802 shown on the pricing page. The page we read shows no end date.
Does Cloudways include email? | Not in the headline price. Hostingstep and DevOpsCube both list email as an extra or a missing feature.
Does Cloudways include backups? | Finding the Universe says backups are not included in the headline price. Check the backup price before you buy.
Is Cloudways good for WooCommerce? | Yes on Medium or larger plans. Hostingstep found DigitalOcean plans completed every request in its load test.
Which Cloudways provider is best? | DigitalOcean plans finished every request in Hostingstep's load test. Vultr High Frequency and Linode scored higher on computing power but dropped some requests at peak.
Does Cloudways have AI features? | Yes. It lists Cloudways Copilot, AI Agents plans and an MCP server. We found no independent test of them.
Who should avoid Cloudways? | Owners of tiny sites on a tight budget, people who want email in the same account, and power users who want full control of every layer.

meta.rl_takeaways:
Hostingstep measured 419 to 447 ms response and 99.996% to 99.999% uptime across five plans.
The 80% Black Friday offer lasts 2 months and saves about 13% over the first year.
Backups, a CDN and email cost extra.
There is a 5-day free trial with no card needed on Flexible plans.
meta.rl_r_verdict: Cloudways is a strong choice for established WordPress and WooCommerce sites that want cloud speed without server work. Three independent sources found it fast and steady. Judge it on the list price, and budget for backups, a CDN and email.
meta.rl_r_buy:
You run an established WordPress or WooCommerce site and want speed with room to grow.
You want to pay by the hour with no contract.
You want control over the provider, server size and data center.
meta.rl_r_skip:
You run a tiny new site on a tight budget.
You want email hosting in the same account.
You want one fixed price with everything included.
meta.rl_r_pros:
Steady response times in a long monitoring test.
No contract and no renewal markup.
A free 5-day trial with no card.
Your choice of cloud provider and server size.
AI Copilot, AI Agents plans and an MCP server.
meta.rl_r_cons:
Backups, a CDN and email cost extra.
No root access, according to DevOpsCube.
Standard-tier support can be slow.
A learning curve compared with simple shared hosting.
The Black Friday discount lasts only 2 months.
meta.rl_r_method:
Pricing and terms | Cloudways' pricing and AI pages, read on 15 November 2026: plan prices, free trials, the Black Friday offer and the AI Agents plans
Independent tests | Hostingstep (five plans monitored October 2025 to May 2026, with load tests and a 40-city test), DevOpsCube (GTmetrix on a 2 GB DigitalOcean server) and Finding the Universe (six years on three sites)
Competitor reviews | Four top-ranking Cloudways reviews read, and their headings and questions compared
Our calculations | The first-year cost table is our own arithmetic from list prices and the offer
When sources disagree | We show both numbers. For prices we use Cloudways' own page
Freshness | Prices and offers are read again before this page goes live
What we did not do | We did not run our own speed or uptime test
